title: AgentTaskRequest v1
description: Generic launch envelope for any agent-worker bot. One queue serves every automation: task.botId selects which bot runs and task.params carries its inputs. Adding a bot therefore requires no change to this schema and no contract-api republish — the bot's own descriptor declares and validates its parameters inside the worker.

botId.description: Which bot to run. Must match a portal descriptor id shipped in the worker (e.g. 'ccss-sicere-reports'). An unknown botId is rejected with error.category = SCHEMA_VIOLATION rather than being retried, since redelivery cannot make it resolvable.

params.description: Bot-specific inputs as a flat map. Values are coerced to strings and exposed to the run as params.<key> bindings. Deliberately open: the required keys, their patterns and defaults are declared by the bot's descriptor and validated in-worker, so a new bot never edits this schema. A missing or malformed param fails fast with error.category = SCHEMA_VIOLATION naming the offending key.
